_comment: Reference measurements captured live from the ArcGIS Sentinel-2 ImageServer on 2026-11-12. The service holds a ROLLING ~14-month window updated daily, so values drift by design. Tolerance is therefore wide; this file checks plumbing and plausibility, not bit-exact reproduction.

cloudcover_units.reasoning: A 0-1 fraction would make all three counts identical, because essentially no scene exceeds 1.0 of a fraction. They are not identical: <1 excludes about 302k records and <20 equals <100 (the whole catalogue). Hence percent.
cloudcover_units.note: Sub-1-percent values are common here; the UI shows them with two decimals so they do not appear as 0.0%.
cloudcover_units.unused_sibling_field: scene_cloud (alias Scene_Cloud) also exists; the adapters do not use it.

service_facts.note: advertised in metadata as 'imagery collected within the past 14 months', updated daily

earth_search_quirks.datetime_short_form: HTTP 400 'datetime value is invalid, does not match RFC3339 format'
earth_search_quirks.cql2_filter: accepted but SILENTLY IGNORED (returned 96.7% cloud under a <20 filter)
earth_search_quirks.query_extension: works; {"eo:cloud_cover": {"lt": 20}} returned only 4.1% and 4.2% cloud scenes
